name: Invoice Extractor
description: Pulls the invoice number and due date out of invoice notes, exactly as written. Runs on 0G Compute's TeeML model (0gm-1.0-35b-a3b).

task.instructions: From each invoice note extract the invoice number (format INV- followed by five digits) and the due date (format YYYY-MM-DD). Copy them exactly as written. Use null when a field is not in the note.
